integratedBehavior: Before any qualification snapshot or measurement begins, the confined destination is atomically replaced with a NONQUALIFYING record whose phase is IN_PROGRESS. Measurement is forbidden if that invalidation cannot publish.
A completed PASS atomically replaces the tombstone only after the canonical locked inputs, exact hardware, clean Git state, calibration authority, raw thresholds, and final state checks succeed.

If PASS publication fails, a completed NONQUALIFYING record is attempted. If that also fails persistently, the already-published IN_PROGRESS tombstone remains authoritative and the command exits nonzero.
All project lifecycle, compatibility, audit, rollback, read-only, production UI, offline, accessibility, performance-source, calibration, and downstream behavior remains unchanged.
